policy.roster: Exact operational 2024–25 CCD LEA 1200180 / FL-06 attachments only; retain all 249 verified pure lower directory profiles.
policy.populations: Require complete reported pure PK–8 offerings, at least one offered grade 3–8, and explicit zero native Survey 2 enrollment in every grade 9–12. 243 profiles are offered-applicable; six primary-only profiles are nonapplicable.
policy.native_eligibility: Independent subject eligibility uses same-year raw individual lunch income and native Florida achievement exclusions; 241 eligible schools per subject. Preserve all source exclusions and three native grade-school profiles with mixed CCD offerings outside the pure cohort.
policy.school_types: Retain exact attached-LEA charter, alternative and special-education flags. Missing native outcomes leave 176 noncharter and 65 charter regular schools eligible; no fit-driven exclusions.
policy.models: Separate 2024–25 native Florida full-year/home-zoned School Grades Math, ELA and Combined ES district OLS; never reuse statewide residuals.
policy.studentization: Externally studentized residuals use deleted-school residual scale with N−3 degrees of freedom.
policy.intervals: Point estimates only: native valid-score denominators are absent. Counts, sampling variances and all interval endpoints remain null, modelwide. An internal zero variance vector is a computational sentinel, never an uncertainty estimate.
policy.combined: Equally weighted mean of eligible Math and ELA proficiency; not percent proficient in both. No counts or sampling variance are inferred.
policy.release: Numerically verified audit only; source and modeling approval remain false pending independent review and separate canonical/browser integration.
